description: This Java interface defines the 'Policy' component of the Eclipse Ditto project, outlining methods for managing policy entries, subjects, resources, labels, lifecycle, JSON serialization, and meta-information within a policy model.

classes.name: JsonFields
classes.description: Inner class enumerating JSON field definitions used for serializing and deserializing Policy objects.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyBuilder with a specified PolicyId or CharSequence.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder initialized with the current Policy instance's entries.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the optional unique identifier of the Policy entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: DEPRECATED: Returns the Policy ID as an Optional String.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema versions for the Policy, which is only V_2.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the optional namespace string of the Policy.

methods.name: getLifecycle
methods.description: Returns the current lifecycle state of the Policy.

methods.name: hasLifecycle
methods.description: Checks if the Policy has the specified lifecycle.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Retrieves all labels associated with the Policy.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the Policy contains an entry for the specified label.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Sets a PolicyEntry, replacing any existing one with the same label.

methods.name: getEntryFor
methods.description: Retrieves the PolicyEntry associated with a specific label.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes an entry by label or by PolicyEntry object.

methods.name: setSubjectsFor
methods.description: Associates Subjects with a specified label, replacing existing subjects.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Associates a single Subject with a specified label.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a Subject by ID or Subject object from a specific label.

methods.name: setResourcesFor
methods.description: Associates Resources with a specified label.

methods.name: setResourceFor
methods.description: Associates a single Resource with a specified label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes Resources by resource type and path or by ResourceKey/Resource object.

methods.name: setEffectedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets EffectedPermissions on a resource within a label.

methods.name: getEffectedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Retrieves the EffectedPermissions for a subject on a resource type/path or ResourceKey.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the Policy contains no entries.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the Policy.

methods.name: getEntriesSet
methods.description: Provides a modifiable set of Policy entries.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of PolicyEntry for processing.

methods.name: toInlinedJson
methods.description: Serializes the Policy into JSON suitable for embedding into other JSON objects, using a predicate or field selector.
